{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace && cd temp_workspace || exit 1
# Capture environment snapshot
env > env_snapshot.txt

# Probe for npm, capture stdout/stderr and exit status
command -v npm > probe_stdout.txt 2> probe_errors.txt
status=$?

echo "exit_status:$status" > probe_result.txt
echo "stdout:" >> probe_result.txt
cat probe_stdout.txt >> probe_result.txt
echo "stderr:" >> probe_result.txt
cat probe_errors.txt >> probe_result.txt

# Prepare concise readiness summary
{
  echo "Readiness summary for npm presence:" 
  echo ""
  echo "PATH: $PATH"
  echo ""
  echo "Probe exit status: $status"
  echo "Probe stdout:"
  cat probe_stdout.txt
  echo ""
  echo "Probe stderr:"
  cat probe_errors.txt
  echo ""
  if [ $status -eq 0 ] && [ -s probe_stdout.txt ]; then
    echo "Conclusion: npm appears present (found at: $(cat probe_stdout.txt))"
  else
    echo "Conclusion: npm does not appear present based on probe."
  fi
} > readiness_summary.txt

# Also output a single token 'yes' or 'no' to stdout for quick answer
if [ $status -eq 0 ] && [ -s probe_stdout.txt ]; then
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no"
fi
"}
